The desk pet release - a tamagotchi moves into the editor sidebar. Five species hatch from tinted eggs, grow from baby to adult, and die of neglect if you stop caring; everything is hand-drawn inline SVG with CSS animations, no image assets.

## Highlights

- **Desk pet panel.** The sidebar footer gains a "Zwierzak" button with a live thumbnail of the pet (a colored dot appears when it needs care, red when it has died) and an overlay panel with the pet's LCD-style screen, four stat bars (food, fun, rest, cleanliness) and five care actions: feed, play, pet, clean, and the sleep toggle. Feeding wakes the pet, playing costs food and rest, each uncleaned poop speeds up the clean drain (up to three on screen), and petting has a 30 s cooldown.
- **Five species.** Kleks the blob, a whiskered cat with a swaying tail, a frog with bump eyes that blink, a chick with flapping wings, and a smiling axolotl with pulsing gills. The species is drawn at random when an egg is laid, and the egg's speckles are tinted with the species color - a guessing game until it hatches. Every generation hatches a fresh species, and the pet grows from baby to adult after a day.
- **Life has consequences.** Any stat left at zero starts a neglect counter; twelve hours of it (cumulative, not necessarily in one stretch) kills the pet. The R.I.P. screen offers a new egg, and the best age achieved by any pet is kept as a family record across generations.
- **The app closing is mercy.** Offline time is capped at 18 h of simulation and the neglect counter stands still for it: closing Pulpit for a week leaves the pet drained to zero but alive. Only an open, ignored editor kills - the counter counts real, awake, in-app neglect.
- **Events worth knowing about.** Hatching, growing up, pooping, waking up and dying all toast in the panel, so an offline hatch announces itself.

## Notes

- The pet lives in the editor only - it is not a tile, it does not sync to tablets, and its state is per-machine (localStorage). Both UI languages get the full experience: Polish plural rules work for the age display ("1 dzień 2 godziny").
- Sidebar thumbnail, panel and a future 2x2 tile all render from one 200x200 viewBox sprite; silhouettes stay readable at small sizes.

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.9.0.exe` below - the updater feed is pointing here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.9.0.apk` over the previous version.
